passages.provision_quote: The department shall identify and compile relevant educational materials and information for health care professionals and patients regarding maternal mental health conditions, including postpartum depression
passages.note: The enacted bill mandates postpartum-depression education materials and a rural ob-gyn/maternal-mental-health advisory committee, not healthcare coverage or payment policy.
Willoughby's yes vote on HB2332 final passage concerns the same education/advisory-committee measure, which does not speak to the coverage-vs-market dimension the healthcare rungs separate.
Bill status confirms Willoughby as prime sponsor of HB2332, now signed law, on the same postpartum-education/advisory-committee measure.

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is Willoughby's sponsorship of, vote for, and signing into law of HB2332 (2025), which mandates postpartum-depression educational materials and creates a rural obstetrics/maternal-mental-health advisory committee; it is silent on who pays for or how to structure healthcare coverage, the dimension the healthcare rungs separate, so no rung is established.
